report_name: Redditch Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: Used to identify potential cycling routes based on 2011 census data for travel-to-work analysis and to model school journey cycling likelihood based on distance and gradient.
specific_evidence_of_impact: Identified potential for increased cycling among school children (e.g., identifying schools where 42 out of every 100 students could potentially cycle) and identified specific areas with high growth potential.
length_of_cycle_network_proposed: 10 primary cycling routes (approx. 45kms), 11 secondary and 12 link cycling routes (approx. 42kms)
